sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*98[^.]*mg[^.]*deciliter[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '40337982' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%98%mg%deciliter%' LIMIT 5
rows: The mean age of the patients was 65 years, 34% were women, and the mean baseline LDL cholesterol level was 98 mg per deciliter
